#### Fields

Per-field output settings. The SQL result determines the actual columns, column order, and types.

Uses the SQL result columns and types. No per-field settings are defined.

#### SQL

```sql
SELECT host, remote_user,
       to_char(
         from_unixtime(to_unixtime(logged_at, '%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z')),
         '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS received_at,
       request, status, bytes, referer, user_agent
FROM access
```

#### SQL

```sql
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS requests, SUM(bytes) AS total_bytes
FROM access
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
```
